hub.subtitle: Import workouts, weigh-ins and steps from your Garmin account

status.connectHint: Paste your Garmin Personal API key to import workouts, weigh-ins and steps.
status.lastFailed: The last sync failed. Try syncing again.

key.label: Personal API key
key.steps: Create the key in Garmin Connect: Settings → Personal API Key, then copy it and paste it here.
key.expiry: The key expires. Garmin emails you before it does; create a new key and reconnect here.

toast.synced_one: Garmin: {{count}} workout, {{weights}} weigh-ins, {{days}} days of activity imported.
toast.synced_other: Garmin: {{count}} workouts, {{weights}} weigh-ins, {{days}} days of activity imported.

notes.text: JoyoRogo reads your Garmin account through Garmin's official Personal API: workouts (type, time, duration, active kcal), weigh-ins, and daily steps and active kcal. Data is read only when you press Sync or open this page.
notes.dedupe: The same workout from Health Connect, Apple Health or Strava is not counted twice. Disconnect removes the key and everything imported from Garmin.

server.notConfigured: Garmin is not available for your account.
server.badKey: The Garmin key is not valid or has expired. Check the key or create a new one in Garmin Connect.
server.retry: Couldn't reach Garmin. Try again later.
server.connectFirst: Connect Garmin first on the profile page.
server.expired: The Garmin key has expired or was revoked. Create a new key and reconnect on the profile page.
